```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        ruby-version: ['3.1', '3.2', '3.3']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: |
          bundle exec rubocop --parallel

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          bundle exec rspec
```

yaml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        ruby-version: ['3.1', '3.2', '3.3']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: |
          bundle exec rubocop --parallel

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          bundle exec rspec
